title: City station readings (hourly): NO2 and PM2.5 from city monitoring stations
summary: Hourly NO2 (ug/m3) and PM2.5 (ug/m3) concentrations from the city's own monitoring stations, keyed by station_id and UTC hour start. The catalog gives about 4.2 million rows, temporal coverage from 2023-01-01 with no end date, and an hourly refresh (last refreshed 2026-10-14). It has no coordinates, so station-to-traffic and station-to-weather matching is not yet possible. Access is by warehouse request to the Environment Monitoring Unit; no data was sampled or delivered.

documentation_excerpts: Hourly NO2 and PM2.5 readings from the city's own monitoring stations. (catalog description)
Station VR-03 (Via Roma) was switched off on 2024-06-30. Its readings stop there. (wiki station_network, last edited 2024-07-01)
airq.station_readings still lists the network as active. Station VR-03 has no readings after 2024-06-30. (wiki station_network)
The other stations report continuously from 2023-01-01. (wiki station_network)
quality_notes: Catalog vs wiki disagreement on station status: wiki station_network (last edited 2024-07-01) says VR-03 was switched off 2024-06-30 and has no readings after that; the catalog entry (exported 2026-10-14) still says status 'active' with no station-status note and an open-ended temporal_coverage end (null).

Catalog refresh metadata (last_refreshed 2026-10-14, hourly cadence) is more recent than the wiki (2024-07-01), so the catalog's open-ended coverage cannot be read as proof that every station reports to the present.
No station coordinates, so station-to-traffic and station-to-weather matching cannot be verified from the catalog.
Timestamps are UTC (ts_utc); the candidate notes that traffic counts are local time, so the join needs an explicit time-zone conversion (not checked against data).
Coverage starts 2023-01-01 per catalog and wiki: no data for the 2004-2005 prototype window, so the N1 prototype need is not met by this source.
No data-quality flags, missing-value convention, or validation status documented in the catalog; behaviour of missing hours is unknown.
No sample was read: access is via a warehouse request, not yet granted, so value ranges, negative values and gap patterns are unverified.
